summary: Acura Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting multiple loans from 65% shareholder Abuse Deterrent Pharma (AD Pharma) totaling $100,000, bringing the principal balance under a secured promissory note to $10,294,279 plus ~$1,090,000 accrued interest at 5.25%. Proceeds fund day-to-day operations. The registrant warns that without additional financing by May 2026, it will scale back operations, furlough/lay off employees, or seek bankruptcy protection, indicating acute financial distress. AD Pharma is controlled by Mr. Schutte. What to watch: imminent risk of insolvency or operational shutdown; note interest jumps to 7.5% on default.
